title: Embedding an Emitting Configuration
statement: Let $m,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $\iota$ be an injective map from the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices, and choose tape contents $T_j:\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Symbol})$ and head positions $h_j\in\mathbb Z$ for the $k$ tapes. Given a symbol list $p$ and an $m$-tape configuration $C$ on input $x$, form a $k$-tape configuration on the same input. It keeps $C$’s state and input-head position, places each of its work tapes and heads at the index specified by $\iota$, uses $T_j$ and $h_j$ at every unused index, and has output equal to the concatenation of $p$ and $C$’s output.
hypotheses_covered: An injection from the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
Supplied tape contents and head positions for the $k$ tapes
An $m$-tape configuration on the fixed input
